name: boundless-apple-vision-poster
image_purpose: campaign key visual and product marketing poster

prompt.project_info: High-end vertical Apple Vision Pro product marketing poster adapted from the source prompt.
prompt.main_subject: Apple Vision Pro headset as the central product, with silver and blue-tinted glass accents and softly glowing EyeSight display.
prompt.composition_elements: Deep space-like black void with cool blue and silver gradients; hero banner with Apple logo and Vision Pro title, feature icons, spec blocks, immersive floating screens, standard-versus-spatial-display comparison, eye-tracking comparison, price at bottom right, clean premium information hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dark high-tech premium aesthetic, crisp studio rim light, subtle electric-blue accents, mysterious otherworldly atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 9:16 poster, sharp product render, clean modern sans-serif typography, balanced grid, legible labels and no invented copy beyond source text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-end vertical 9:16 Apple Vision Pro marketing poster on a deep black space-like void with cool blue and silver gradients, central silver headset with blue-tinted glass and softly glowing EyeSight display, premium hero banner with source-specified Apple Vision Pro title and feature icons, dark rounded key-spec blocks, immersive floating spatial screens, standard-versus-spatial display comparison, eye-tracking comparison, precise clean sans-serif typography, crisp studio rim lighting, electric-blue accents, mysterious otherworldly luxury-tech aesthetic, source-specified price at bottom right, no invented text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, blurry product, warped typography, misspelled text, duplicate headset, low resolution, plastic surfaces, watermark, random logo, extra icons
